notes: The official 1405 reference lists of the dental specialty board (دانشنامه/گواهینامه تخصصی) and promotion (ارتقا) exams, one list per specialty, as published by the medical education assessment center (sanjeshp.ir, Content.aspx?click=26, section «دانشنامه تخصصی دندانپزشکی»). Each list applies to both exam types unless a row names its own exam_types. Books are one row each; the journals and named articles a list adds are summarised in one row per specialty («مقاله‌ها و ژورنال‌های اعلام‌شده») whose scope says what they are; the full article lists stay in the PDFs. Scopes are copied as printed, digits in Latin form.
